draft.subject: Sparq — Japan rollout for online eyewear discovery
draft.body:
Hi Sparq team,

We’re A-one Road, a Yokohama-based company supporting commerce technology companies with Japan market development. We see an opportunity for Sparq in frame filtering for Japanese Shopify online eyewear retailers, helping shoppers narrow large assortments.

Japan’s May 2026 labour survey found regular-staff shortages at 34% of surveyed wholesale/retail establishments. For eyewear teams facing staffing constraints, self-service frame discovery could reduce repetitive product-selection inquiries.

We can lead one year of paid Japan market development, identifying the initial entry application, evaluating buyer requirements, shaping local introduction, and developing partner channels. Japanese buyer evidence would determine filter vocabulary and deployment priorities. Can we help plan and execute Sparq’s Japan rollout around this eyewear application?

https://calendar.app.google/adKEhXC4UWhQXfJp6

Best regards,
Kazuma Tamura
Founder & CEO, A-one Road Co., Ltd. (Yokohama, Japan)
